measures.id: Education Capital Improvements Sales and Use Tax
measures.title: Education Capital Improvements Sales and Use Tax Act Referendum for Dorchester County
measures.summary: Would impose a special one percent sales and use tax in Dorchester County for up to 15 years to pay for education capital projects, with 85% of revenue to Dorchester School District Two and 15% to Dorchester School District Four. Each district would use 10% of its share to reduce the debt service millage on its existing general obligation bonds and 90% for listed projects, including new and renovated schools, roofs, HVAC, buses, playgrounds and technology.
measures.yesMeans: A one percent sales and use tax would be imposed in Dorchester County for up to 15 years to fund the listed school projects and property tax relief for school debt.
measures.noMeans: The special one percent education capital sales and use tax would not be imposed.
